LanguageData.USAC_Faction.label: United Stellar Armament Company
LanguageData.USAC_Faction.description: A profit-driven bloc of resource developers and armed trading houses. It comes from a world that colonization dragged into enlightenment and then into interstellar reach, where countless vast corporations fused - through military dominance and one merger after another - into this man-eating leviathan. Its purpose here is simple: secure a foothold, and prepare to take the whole surface.
